name: desk-slack
description: Claude Code mod that opens the Slack DMs and group DMs sent to you as conversations in a side pane (/desk-slack): recent messages, replying, closing, and a notification when a new one arrives. Reads Slack through the Slack MCP server Claude Code already has connected. Pairs with desk-look, whose status band shows the unread count

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of desk-slack's own labels. auto follows desk-look's language, or Claude Code's language setting in /config without desk-look (Korean when it names Korean, English otherwise)

slackNotify.title: Slack notification
slackNotify.description: Send a notification when a new Slack DM or group DM arrives (checked once a minute while the /desk-slack tools have allow rules). off keeps the pane and desk-look's ✉ chip without notifications
